items.text: Who in this room would you most like to swap lives with for a week?
What's the most embarrassing thing you've done to impress someone?
Have you ever sent a message to the wrong person? What did it say?
What's the most awkward date you've been on?
Who here do you think has the worst taste in music?
What's your most embarrassing crush from the past?
What's something you did that you hope nobody here ever finds out?
Which person in the group would be the best wingman for you?
Have you ever stalked someone's profile for far too long? Who?
What's the most petty reason you've ever stopped talking to someone?
What's the worst thing you've ever said while angry?
Which person here would survive longest in a horror movie?
Who here would you least like to be stuck in a lift with?
What's the weirdest thing you've done while home alone?
What's your biggest red flag?
If you could read one person's mind in this room, whose would it be?
What's the most you've ever spent on something completely pointless?
What's a rule you break all the time?
Have you ever laughed at a really bad moment? When?
What's the strangest compliment you've ever received?
Let the group read out your most recent search history entry.
Text "I need to tell you something" to the last person you messaged. Don't explain.
Do your best flirty wink at every person in the room.
Let the group post a silly story on your phone, no faces allowed.
Swap an item of clothing with the person next to you for the rest of the game.
Say something nice about every person in the room, with a straight face.
Do a dramatic slow-motion run across the room.
Let someone pick a song and dance to it for fifteen seconds.
Call a friend and sing them Happy Birthday, even if it isn't their birthday.
Read your last sent message out loud in a dramatic voice.
Let the group choose your profile picture for one day.
Do your best villain laugh for ten seconds.
Give a heartfelt speech to a random object in the room.
Let the person on your right send one emoji from your phone to anyone.
Do an impression of someone here until they guess who it is.
Eat a spoonful of the weirdest thing in the kitchen.
Reveal the most embarrassing photo in your gallery, or pick another dare.
Whisper everything you say until your next turn.
Pretend you're proposing to a cushion.
Try to lick your elbow. Everyone watches.
